targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state == "open")
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.severity == "high" or r.severity == "disaster")
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.severity == "disaster")
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.acknowledged == "false")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state == "open")
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state == "resolved")
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "duration_seconds")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state == "resolved")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> mean()

panels.title: Incidentes por Severidade ao Longo do Tempo

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.severity == "disaster")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "disaster"}))

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.severity == "high")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "high"}))

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.severity == "average")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "average"}))

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.severity == "warning")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "warning"}))

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["severity"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)

from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_zabbix_problem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "trigger_name")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "host", "severity", "state", "acknowledged", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "trigger", _time: "timestamp"})
